culprit_citations.quoted_text: Burgess Point Purchaser Corporation | Initial Term Loan (First Lien) | ... | $ | 4,696,356 | $ | 4,206,281 | 2.2 | %

rationale: FX02 flags fair_value_currency value U_USD as not USD, but the raw schedule of investments presents the fair value column in dollars. A representative flagged holding, Burgess Point Purchaser Corporation, shows Fair Value with a dollar sign and value 4,206,281, and the schedule total is also dollar-denominated. The source therefore supports USD-denominated fair values; the defect is the rule treating the U_USD unit label as non-USD rather than a data error in the holding.
